decisions.Kwic: 正法眼藏。涅槃妙心。實相無相。微妙法門。不立文字。教外別傳。付囑摩訶迦葉。

Decision.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), Shakyamuni Buddha section. Shakyamuni Buddha is the exact speaker: after Mahakasyapa alone smiles when the flower is raised, Shakyamuni Buddha names the treasury of the true eye of the teaching, the wondrous mind of nirvana, the subtle gate not established in words, and the separate transmission outside the teachings, then entrusts it to Mahakasyapa. Mahakasyapa is the sole smiling responder and recipient, not the speaker.
